# airflow-supervisor

> Apache Airflow integration for supervisord-managed jobs

## Pages

- [airflow-supervisor](index.html.md): Run and monitor supervisord-managed jobs from Apache Airflow.
- [Tutorial: run a supervised job from Airflow](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will define a supervisord-managed job in airflow-config YAML and load it as an Airflow DAG.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover persistent services, monitoring, remote hosts, and task composition.
- [Why Airflow delegates process ownership](docs/src/explanation.html.md): Airflow is effective at scheduling and coordinating finite task instances, but its worker process is not always the right owner for a long-running service or...
